notes.subject: לפיד בוז לעשתות שאנן
notes.rationale: Line famously opaque: 'a torch despised in the thoughts of the secure' (KJV/ylt) vs 'contempt for misfortune in the thought of him at ease' (asv/bsb read בוז as verb-like 'contempt for the stumbling' not the lamp).

notes.subject: tiɲɛnabagaw
notes.rationale: למועדי (waverers) rendered with the full picture: those whose foot wavers/stumbles — gloss keeps 'tiɲɛnabagaw ma' (to the waverers) plus 'sen' (foot) as separate token.

translation: Pɛtɛrɔ bɛ jɔ hɛrɛma-miiribagaw ka miiri kɔnɔ; o labɛnna wiɲɛbɔloma tiɲɛnabagaw ma.
